description: Search Pure Report's neutral, bias-scored news. Returns articles with neutral summaries in our own words; bias_score (0-100) rates the ORIGINAL source reporting (0 = wire-neutral, 100 = advocacy), NOT the returned summary, which is neutral by design. Each result also lists the event(s) it belongs to — pass an event slug to get_event for the neutral writeup or compare_coverage for cross-outlet framing. Ranked by relevance and recency.

limit.description: Max results to RETURN, 1-40 (default 15). Does not affect total_matches, which always reports how many articles matched.

offset.description: Skip this many matches — page through results beyond the 40-row limit. The response echoes offset/returned/next_offset; next_offset is null on the last page.

published_after.description: Only articles published on/after this date. 'YYYY-MM-DD' or full ISO. Use with published_before to bound a period, e.g. coverage during June.

published_before.description: Only articles published on/before this date. 'YYYY-MM-DD' or full ISO.

query.description: Keywords or phrase, e.g. "Iran sanctions" or "2026 election".

topic.description: Optional topic-slug filter. An unrecognized value searches all topics and returns a warning.

name: search_news

result_composition.description: Factual description of what the returned set is ABOUT. Search is lexical, so every query term appears in every result; this reports whether a term is the SUBJECT (title/entities/lede) or only a body mention, plus the entity distribution. Measurements only — no verdict.

total_matches.description: TOTAL articles matching the query, independent of `limit` — not the number returned. len(results) < total_matches means more exist.

title: Search neutral news
